blocks.text: Yeh chapter physics ke do bare shobon (areas) par baat karta hai, yaani transverse waves ki polarization aur gravitational waves. Polarization ke hawale se physical optics light waves ke rawayye aur maadde (matter) ke saath un ke taamul (interaction) se mutalliq hai.

Interference aur diffraction ke asraat light ki wave nature sabit karte hain. Magar yeh mazahir nahi batate ke light waves longitudinal hain ya transverse. Light ki polarization batati hai ke light waves apni fitrat mein transverse hain.

Transverse mechanical waves mein, jaise khinche hue taar mein paida hone wali, medium ke zarron ki vibrations waves ke phailao ki simt ke amudi (perpendicular) hoti hain. Vibrations amudi (vertical), ufuqi (horizontal) ya kisi bhi simt mein ho sakti hain (Fig. 8.1). In mein se har soorat mein transverse mechanical wave ko polarized kaha jata hai.

blocks.alt: Do taar, har ek neeche baen sire par haath mein pakri hui aur tirchhi daen oopar jati hui. Oopar wale taar (a) par lehar oopar neeche hai, saath khara dohra teer; neeche wale taar (b) par lehar ufuqi (horizontal) satah mein daen baen hai, saath para dohra teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.1: Taar par transverse waves, (a) amudi (vertical) satah mein aur (b) ufuqi satah mein polarized (kitab ki Figure 8.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono taaron par lehar taar ke amudi (perpendicular) hilti hai, isi liye yeh transverse hai. (a) mein zarre sirf oopar neeche hilte hain, to plane of polarization khari hai; (b) mein sirf daen baen, to plane ufuqi hai. Jis lehar ki vibration ek hi satah mein rahe woh polarized kehlati hai.

blocks.title: Plane of polarization
blocks.text: Plane of polarization woh satah (plane) hai jis mein medium ke zarron ki vibration ki simt aur wave ke phailao ki simt dono shamil hon.

Jhoolte charge se paida hone wali light wave electric field vector E ki wafqe wafqe tabdeeli par mushtamil hai jis ke saath magnetic field vector B hai, dono ek doosre ke amudi. Aam light mein tamam mumkin satahon mein vibration ke ajza (components) hote hain; aisi light unpolarized hai. Doosri taraf agar vibrations sirf ek satah tak mehdood hon to light polarized kehlati hai. Unpolarized light Fig. 8.2 mein dikhai gayi hai: incandescent bulb ki light mein har simt mein vibrations hain. Unpolarized light ke sources ki misalein suraj ki roshni, incandescent bulbs, fluorescent bulbs, aur mom batti ya aag ki roshni hain.

blocks.alt: Neeche baen jalta hua incandescent bulb. Bulb se ek lakeer oopar ek nuqte tak jati hai jahan se peele teer har simt mein bahar ki taraf hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.2: Incandescent bulb ki unpolarized light ki vibrations har simt mein hoti hain (kitab ki Figure 8.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Peele teer electric field E ki vibration ki simtein hain. Bulb ki light mein E har simt mein (sab satahon mein) hilta hai; koi ek simt khaas nahi. Isi ko unpolarized light kehte hain.

blocks.title: Polarization
blocks.text: Polarization woh amal hai jis se light waves ki electric aur magnetic vibrations ek hi vibration ki satah tak mehdood kar di jati hain. Yeh sirf transverse waves, jaise light waves, ki khasiyat hai; longitudinal waves jaise sound waves mein yeh nahi hoti. Light waves ke electric field vector E ka kisi khaas simt mein rukh (orientation) polarization ki bunyad hai.
Unpolarized light ko polarized kaise kiya jaye?

items: Light ko polarizing filter (maslan polaroid sheet) se guzar kar.
Polarizing beam splitter istemal kar ke.
Kuch optical crystals ya materials (maslan calcite ya quartz) istemal kar ke.

blocks.text: Unpolarized light ko polarized karne ka sab se aam tareeqa use polarizing filter, jaise polarizing beam splitter ya polaroid sheet, se guzarna hai. Jab unpolarized light filter se guzarti hai to sirf woh electric field vector guzar sakta hai jo filter ke axis ke mutawazi ho, baqi tamam vectors ruk jate hain; nateeja light polarized ho jati hai (Fig. 8.3). Yun saada lafzon mein unpolarized light ko polarized light mein badalne ka amal polarization kehlata hai.

blocks.alt: Ek shua (neeli lakeer) daen neeche ki taraf jati hai. Filter se pehle surkh E teer kai simton mein hain. Shua khari lakeeron aur khare axis teer wale polarized filter se guzarti hai. Filter ke baad sirf ek khara surkh E teer hai. Labels: E, Polarized filter, Axis, Polarization direction, Direction of ray.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.3: Polarized light ki simt (kitab ki Figure 8.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Filter ka axis khara hai, is liye E ka sirf woh hissa guzarta hai jo axis ke mutawazi (parallel) hai. Baqi simton wale ajza ruk jate hain. Filter ke baad E sirf ek (khari) simt mein hilta hai: yeh polarization direction hai, aur shua apni simt (direction of ray) mein chalti rehti hai.

blocks.prompt: Polarization ki tareef kijiye. Light polarized kyun ho sakti hai magar sound kyun nahi (MCQ 8.1; comprehensive question 8.1)?
blocks.explanation: Polarization light wave ki electric aur magnetic vibrations ko ek satah tak mehdood karna hai. Sirf transverse waves, jin ki vibrations safar ki simt ke aar paar hon, ki simt mehdood ki ja sakti hai; light transverse hai, to polarized ho sakti hai. Sound longitudinal hai: us ki vibrations safar ki simt ke saath hain, to mehdood karne ke liye satah ka koi intikhab nahi aur woh polarized nahi ho sakti. MCQ 8.1 ka jawab (b) hai, light ki kisi khaas satah mein vibrate karne ki khasiyat.

items: Interference aur diffraction batate hain ke light wave hai; polarization batati hai ke woh transverse hai. Plane of polarization: vibration ki simt aur phailao ki simt dono par mushtamil.

Unpolarized light tamam satahon mein vibrate karti hai (suraj, bulbs, mom batti); polarized ek mein. Tareeqe: polarizing filter (polaroid), polarizing beam splitter, crystals (calcite, quartz); filter sirf apne axis ke saath wala E component guzarta hai.
